{{Conjecture}}
A '''black marketeer''' was making a deal<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Fair Play}}</ref> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Fair Play" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> In order to ensure there was no foul play, they wanted a well-known person present to discourage troublemakers.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to the [[Black market/Legends|black marketeer's]] deal. The unexpected presence of the companion, who fit the black mareteer's criteria of being well known, was enough to unnerve any potential troublemakers. As a result, the deal was a safe, albeit tense, event.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The black marketeer was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', within the Crew Skill Mission "Fair Play," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
